title: BLACKPINK Is So Back: Stream the Band’s New Mini-Album ‘Deadline’ Now
summary: The set features a total of five tracks.
contentText:
At long last, BLACKPINK ‘s mini-album Deadline is here.

Arriving four years after the girl group comprised of LISA, ROSÉ, JENNIE and JISOO last dropped a collection of songs — reaching No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with album Born Pink — Deadline features a total of five tracks. The set includes lead single “Jump,” which dropped last summer and reached No. 28 on the Billboard Hot 100 , as well as “Go,” “Me and My,” “Champion” and “Fxxxboy.”

The project has been a long time coming for BLINKs, who have patiently waited for the ladies to reunite on new music for years. Last year, the foursome got back together for a sprawling stadium tour, before which they’d spent time apart to work on solo endeavors. LISA, ROSÉ and JENNIE all released debut solo albums — titled Alter Ego, Rosie and Ruby , respectively — while JISOO unveiled EP Amortage.

Some of the members also pursued acting opportunities as well, with LISA making her debut in White Lotus while JENNIE starred in The Idol and JISOO served as the leading lady in Netflix’s upcoming series Boyfriend on Demand .

But while each of them thrived as soloists, all of the women have expressed missing working with their bandmates prior to reuniting. “I’ve missed doing tours with them. I miss our silly moments,” JENNIE told Billboard in her January 2025 cover story. “Everyone took their own journey [during] this time, and I’m excited to share that with the girls. I want to say it’s going to be the most powerful [versions] of ourselves that anyone has seen.”
